label: Illustrative sample data
note: These rows are illustrative and describe no student. They show the shapes a review queue takes once a course has run for a term (PRD §7.17, FR-186, D-035, D-096).

rows.heading: Coherence gaps
rows.body: Runs where the frame and the filed decision point in different directions, gathered so the pattern can be read across a section rather than one run at a time.

rows.heading: Boundary cases
rows.body: Runs sitting on a band boundary on one dimension, where the descriptor could be read either way and the instructor's judgment is the one that settles it.

rows.heading: Appeals
rows.body: Runs a student has asked to have looked at again. Nothing here is a dispute about conduct; an appeal is a request to read the evidence together.

rows.heading: Pattern flags
rows.body: Runs carrying an observation worth a conversation — every dimension at one band, or a defense nobody answered — never a conclusion about the student.

rows.heading: Batch confirmation
rows.body: Runs whose seven drafts are ready to confirm together, each still opening to its own replay before anything is decided.
